title: TypeScript rewrite
desc: Plan: docs/brainstorming/typescript-rewrite.md (decisions settled). One PR per phase; every phase leaves the repo working and CI green; every phase after the scaffold ships a user-visible change.

title: Phase 1: Scaffold
desc: Shipped as PR #56 (squash ee09573). flake + npins (kolu@4d8a668, nixpkgs), Bun, drishti-style workspace, bunfig.toml isolated linker, @kolu/* hydrate + check-kolu-deps scripts, justfile whose `check` recipe IS the CI DAG ([metadata("ci")], odu-only — the planned GHA wrapper was dropped mid-flight at the human's direction), linux + darwin lanes, bun2nix from juspay/bun2nix#2. Effect wired in from day one: effect + @effect/platform-node at the kolu pin's exact version (4.0.0-beta.106) with single-copy overrides, and packages/core shipped a real @kolu/surface + Effect Schema cell exercised by bun test — that package is gone as of phase 2, which split it into format/store/surface/server/web.

title: Phase 2: See your outline
desc:
Serve a directory, parse and validate the .jsonl files (format core: unique ids, dangling refs, cycles, stored derived state), render the tree read-only in the browser via a minimal surface view. Visible: your outline in a browser tab — or the validation error, with file:line.
Resolved 2026-08-09: entrypoint is `olai web <dir> [--port] [--host]` (nix-built binary; just serve and nix run wrap it; loopback default); UI is a sidebar of found outlines + one tree per route; mirrors render the target subtree inline, marked (cycle-safe); nodes render title with styled #tags, derived done/doing/open status, date badge, and desc as sanitized markdown; packages/store is born this phase in load-once form (revision-tagged snapshot, codec seam; watcher/probe arrive in phase 3 — see docs/brainstorming/architecture.live-store.md); an invalid set renders an error view listing ALL errors with file:line, grouped by file, cross-file errors in their own section; the tree has client-local collapse/expand; e2e is Cucumber + Playwright in kolu's packages/tests shape, features written fresh for this phase (nothing ported from the racket branch). Specs: docs/format.md, docs/architecture.md.

title: Phase 3: It stays live
desc: Probe-based staleness over the recursive directory, snapshot stream, error cell. Visible: edit a file or git pull, the page updates without reload; break a file, the page keeps last-good and shows the error banner.

title: Phase 4: An agent can edit it
desc: Ops (add, mark, move, archive; fractional-ord insertion; temp-file → re-validate → rename → commit) exposed as MCP tools over the ACP wiring (@agentclientprotocol/sdk). Visible: tell a coding agent to check something off and watch the browser update; a refused write (derived state, listing the unfinished children) shows in the agent's tool output.

title: Phase 5: Talk to it in the UI
desc: The chat panel — ACP session projected into surface events; send, stream, cancel. Visible: full chat-driven editing loop inside the web app.

title: Phase 6: Edit it yourself
desc: Keyboard-driven outline editing — add, check off, reorder, move — through the same procedures. Visible: the Workflowy loop without the agent.

title: Phase 7: Editor growth
desc: Drag-drop, .md document rendering, views, command palette — each its own PR against this roadmap, each user-visible by nature.
